text:
maria: Heads-up — infra-alert flagged an ECC spike in pool-west-3. 5m window shows 112 correctable ECCs (baseline ~3). P50 latency up ~4ms. tagging eng-infra for triage.

infra-bot: ALERT: ecc-rate-threshold exceeded on pool-west-3. metric: gpu.ecc.correctable.count = 112 (5m). affected cards: gpu-7a2, gpu-7a4, gpu-7b1. linked dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/infra/ecc?orgId=1

dan: Which jobs are hitting those cards? any OOMs or Xid errors noted?

maria: Early look — mostly model-batch jobs and a couple infra-maint retries. No Xid or OOMs in last 10m, just retries. Cards listed above.

li: Can we run the confidence/behavior classifier before doing anything heavy (auto-drain)? prefer soft actions first.

sanjay: +1. Auto-drain has caused churn for transient spikes. Proposal: require sustained >3m spike + confidence >= 0.75 + cross-pool correlation for auto-drain. Otherwise soft_quarantine.

maria: Ran quick scoring utility. Output below. Not at auto-drain threshold. Voting NO auto-drain for now.

infra-bot: ```
$ python tools/ecc_score.py --pool pool-west-3 --window 300
{
  "confidence": 0.62,
  "spike_slope": 0.12,
  "sustained_secs": 240,
  "card_count": 3,
  "error_type": "correctable"
}
```

dan: Good — so next steps: 1) tag nodes soft_quarantine 2) throttle heavy batch jobs hitting those cards 3) observe for 20-30m, escalate if rate increases. Who can apply tags?

li: I can apply tags and add an annotation on the dashboard. Command I'll run: `/ops tag --pool pool-west-3 --tag soft_quarantine --reason "ecc spike 2169876543"`

maria: Tagged now. Also throttled batch job concurrency by 30% for the pool. Monitoring console.

sanjay: Add rollback safety: if error rate doesn't fall by 50% in 20m escalate to manual drain discussion (oncall + infra lead). No automatic drain until confidence>=0.8 and sustained>10m. Update runbook accordingly.

maria: I'll update the runbook and add the new thresholds under "auto-drain safeguards". Scheduling a follow-up check at +20m.

ops-bot: Action logged: ticket INF-4521 created. assignees: maria, li. follow-up set for 20 minutes.

maria: If we hit >180 ECCs in any 5m window we re-open drain discussion immediately. For now we keep soft_quarantine and watch. :eyes:

dan: Thanks all — nice measured approach. Will keep an eye on model latency and billing impact (throttling bumped p99 infra by ~1.8%).

li: I'll post a short note in the runbook about this confidence calibration so oncall knows why we won't auto-drain low-confidence spikes.

maria: closing the triage thread for now — re-open if metrics worsen.
